CHICKENS, LLAMAS & MANIACS SHARE CROWN 
IN TIGHT WEEK 4; ‘RIDERS’ LEAD DOWN TO 1 GAME

Mike’s Chickens, Mom’s Maniacs and Tati’s Llamas share the Week 4 crown with 11-5 records –- the Chickens and Llamas drawing within 1 game of Dick’s Roughriders’ continuing season lead.

The Llamas grew their season lead in Unique Hits, cashing the week’s only Coonskin with Falcons over Saints.

And PFPI’s 23rd season of the modern era moves on -– now four weeks down and 14 to go in the marathon run for the Dad’s Dynamics Championship Trophy.
